Pyodide 314.0.7 – CPython 3.14.2 compiled to WebAssembly with Emscripten 5.0.3 – unchanged: the Python of Cutadapt
(../../cutadapt/5.2/), of Bracken's Python programs (../../bracken/3.1/) and of MACS3 (../../macs3/3.0.5/)
The files of the release pyodide-core-314.0.7 (https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/releases/tag/314.0.7) that they need:
pyodide.mjs, pyodide.asm.mjs, pyodide.asm.wasm, python_stdlib.zip and pyodide-lock.json. One copy serves all three:
assets/js/python-worker.mjs is given this folder, and checks that the versions of Pyodide and Python are those that the
tool's manifest names.

Next to them, the thirteen packages of Pyodide's own distribution of the same release that MACS3 needs, unchanged – the
wheels that Pyodide's catalogue (pyodide-lock.json) names, with the SHA-256 it gives: NumPy 2.4.6, SciPy 1.18.0,
pandas 3.0.2, scikit-learn 1.8.0, h5py 3.13.0, joblib 1.5.3, threadpoolctl 3.6.0, python-dateutil 2.9.0.post0,
pytz 2026.1.post1, tzdata 2025.3, six 1.17.0, packaging 26.1 and pkgconfig 1.6.0 (Pyodide built them from their sources
with its recipes, pyodide-recipes 314-20260911). MACS3's manifest lists them; the worker checks each against it and
against the catalogue before Python loads any of them, and loads no other package. Cutadapt and Bracken do not use them.

Licences: Pyodide and hiwire are under the Mozilla Public License 2.0; CPython under the PSF licence; Emscripten's
runtime under MIT and NCSA; the libraries in it – libffi, xz, zstd, SQLite, bzip2 and zlib – under their own
(permissive) licences. runtime-notices/ holds their notices, unchanged, as genomics-wasm ships them with Bracken
(runtime-notices/README.md says what each is; runtime-notices/manifest.json gives their SHA-256); Cutadapt and MACS3
come with the same notices (../../cutadapt/5.2/runtime-notices/, ../../macs3/3.0.5/runtime-notices/). The thirteen
packages are under BSD, MIT and Apache 2.0 licences, and some hold compiled libraries – OpenBLAS with LAPACK and libf2c
(SciPy), Boost, HDF5 (h5py) and zlib: their licence files and notices are in ../../macs3/3.0.5/scientific-notices/ (a
folder for each package, and one for its wheel; ../../macs3/3.0.5/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt lists them). Pyodide's
recipes are under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. The source code of Pyodide, hiwire and the recipes is in
../../../licenses/sources/ (pyodide-314.0.7.tar.gz, hiwire-6a1e67280a15d929ebeceee54a6358c9c8d5f697.tar.gz,
pyodide-recipes-314-20260911.tar.gz).
Upstream source: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide (tag 314.0.7) and https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide-recipes (tag
314-20260911).
